[SWS_DM_00017] Calculation of the FDC based on the internal debounce counter
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04125, RS_Diag_04190
⌈
The DM shall calculate the FDC according to UDS, based on the value and range of
the internal debounce counter by linear mapping in order to achieve a value range of
-128 ... +127.
⌋
